title:
Ben Shelton in the post-match media huddle:

"I'm tired. That was a war, epic match, so physical. Carlos is one of the greatest champions in our sport already at 23 years old. It's always fun being on the court against him. 

It's ridiculous some of the stuff he comes up with sometimes. But, yeah, the most enjoyable match that I've had in my career, for sure."

title:
Alex Michelsen on his embrace with Frances after their QF clash:

"I wasn't saying much. I was trying to keep it together, and I didn't do a good job of that. He was saying a lot of nice personal things: 'When I'm older, you're going to be here, and we're going to play again in this type of circumstance.' All that good stuff.

He's a great guy for consoling me in that moment."

author: José Morgado

title:
Alcaraz.

“It’s always tough to lose these kinds of matches, but you have to put things into perspective. I train hard every day to experience emotions like the ones I experienced today. I think it was a magical night. We both played great tennis, and it means a lot to me to have been able to compete at this level. I missed this: looking for solutions during matches, suffering, enjoying the crowd. I’m going home happy. I want to rest, train hard and compete for the rest of the year because there
author: José Morgado

title:
Alcaraz after losing to Shelton.

“As I said before the tournament started, my goal was to compete, play these kinds of matches and, above all, do it while staying healthy. I came very close. So I’m not going to be disappointed about not getting the win in the end. I’m happy and proud of myself and the way I fought throughout the match. I’m leaving the court happy, with a smile on my face and healthy, and that’s what I needed. The most important thing is that I’m leaving healthy.”
author: José Morgado
